name: Shop Explorer – AI Powered Inventory Management & Bulk Editor Shop Manager for WooCommerce
author: wpazleen

sections.description:
Shop Explorer is a WooCommerce store management plugin that puts your products, orders, customers, and revenue analytics on one screen. Built-in AI writes your product content, analyzes your sales trends, and answers questions about your store through a chat assistant, so you get data-driven answers without leaving the dashboard.

Most WooCommerce stores end up running several plugins at once: one for bulk editing order, bulk editing product, another for analytics, and something else for customer data, each with its own interface. Shop Explorer brings all of that together. From one dashboard you can bulk edit thousands of products, process orders, browse your customer base, and let AI draft product descriptions, set prices and stock, or write customer notes.

Shop Explorer | Documentation

Why Store Owners Choose Shop Explorer

  • Single-screen store management – products, orders, customers, and revenue analytics together in one dashboard, with no switching between separate tools or screens.
  • Bulk edit WooCommerce products, including variations: update prices, stock, categories, and status across thousands of products at once.
  • AI does the writing. Generate product names, descriptions, pricing, SKUs, and stock from a single prompt, and ask the built-in chat assistant what’s driving your numbers.
  • AI revenue analysis – get insight into sales trends, growth patterns, and overall store performance, plus practical suggestions for improving conversions.
  • Connect the AI provider you already use: Google Gemini, OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, DeepSeek, or OpenRouter for access to 100+ models.
  • Bulk order management – update statuses, export to CSV, and process hundreds of orders in seconds.
  • Full customer management, including lifetime value, purchase history, and CSV export of your entire customer base.
  • Threshold warnings and a validation engine catch mistakes before any bulk change is written to your database.
  • No coding required. The interface is built for store owners, not just developers.

One Screen. Everything. No Switching.

Open Shop Explorer and you see your entire store at a glance. Switch between managing products in bulk, processing orders, viewing customer data, and reading live revenue charts, without navigating away or losing your place.

Most free WooCommerce management plugins handle one of these jobs at a time: a separate plugin for bulk editing, another for analytics. Shop Explorer puts bulk editing, order management, customer data, and analytics in a single dashboard with one consistent interface.

Bulk Edit WooCommerce Products

A fast, full-featured product editing engine that replaces WooCommerce’s limited built-in bulk editor:

  • Bulk price updates – change regular price, sale price, or apply percentage increases and decreases across thousands of products at once
  • Bulk stock management – set quantities, fix stock status, and resolve low-stock issues across your catalog
  • Bulk category and tag assignment, without opening a single product individually
  • Bulk status changes – publish, draft, or privatize multiple products at once, and toggle featured status in seconds
  • Variation bulk editing – update variation-specific pricing, stock, and attributes at scale
  • Batch processing with configurable batch sizes (default 5,000 products) and memory-efficient handling for large catalogs
  • Real-time progress tracking with live success/failure counts, detailed logs, and the ability to cancel mid-run

Advanced product filtering:

  • Filter by product type (Simple, Variable, Grouped, External), price range, stock quantity, category, tag, attribute, featured status, or on-sale status
  • Search by product name, SKU, or description
  • Sort by date created, name, price, stock quantity, or SKU, ascending or descending

Manage WooCommerce Orders in Bulk

Handle your entire order workflow without clicking through individual order screens:

  • Bulk order status updates – move hundreds of orders from Processing to Completed in one action
  • Bulk order export to CSV or Excel with custom field selection
  • Bulk customer notifications sent to multiple recipients at once
  • A complete order detail panel covering customer info, payment, shipping, notes, and refunds
  • Inline order notes – add, edit, and delete without leaving the order list
  • Advanced search by customer name, email, product name, or order ID
  • Date range presets (last 7, 30, 60, or 90 days, or a custom range), with filters for status, price range, item count, and customer

AI Tools Built Into Shop Explorer

Shop Explorer connects to the AI provider of your choice and uses it across the plugin, not as a bolted-on extra.

The AI content generator can produce product names, descriptions, pricing, SKUs, and stock levels from a single prompt, so setting up new products takes minutes instead of an afternoon. The AI revenue analysis turns your sales data into plain-language insights about trends, growth patterns, and where conversions are slipping, with specific suggestions rather than generic tips. When you want to dig deeper, the Ask Anything chat assistant answers questions about your store directly from your live data and remembers earlier questions for follow-ups.

Pick the provider that fits your budget:

  • OpenAI – GPT-4o, GPT-4o-mini, GPT-4.1, O4-mini
  • Google Gemini – Gemini 2.0 Flash, Gemini 2.5 Flash-Lite
  • Anthropic Claude
  • DeepSeek
  • X.AI Grok
  • OpenRouter – access to 100+ models from multiple providers

You can switch providers at any time without losing indexed content or chat history.

Real-Time WooCommerce Analytics Dashboard

After bulk editing prices or processing a batch of orders, your revenue charts update live, without leaving the page or waiting for a separate analytics plugin to refresh.

  • Interactive revenue charts powered by Recharts, rendered live in your browser
  • Daily, weekly, and monthly revenue breakdowns
  • Average Order Value (AOV) tracking, with period-over-period comparison
  • Top-performing products ranked by revenue and units sold
  • Growth indicators showing percentage change versus the previous period for every key metric
  • Order trend visualization to spot seasonal peaks ahead of time
  • Custom date filtering – today, yesterday, last 7/15/30 days, or a custom range
  • Export analytics data to CSV for team sharing or external reporting
  • Total orders broken down by status (Pending / Processing / Completed), plus low-stock alerts on the same screen

WooCommerce Customer Management

A complete customer hub inside your WordPress admin, right next to your product and order management:

  • Full customer database with advanced search and filtering
  • Complete purchase history and order tracking per customer
  • Customer Lifetime Value (CLV) calculation for every account
  • Registration date and last-order date tracking
  • Bulk customer export to CSV, plus segmentation tools for deeper analysis

Built-In Safety for Bulk Operations

Speed without safety is risky, so every bulk operation in Shop Explorer includes a threshold system, progress tracking, and batch processing working together.

The threshold system lets you configure the maximum number of records a single operation can affect, with a confirmation dialog before any critical change is written to your database. While an operation runs, you get live progress bars, success and failure counts, detailed logs, and the option to cancel mid-way. Batch processing handles tens of thousands of records with configurable batch sizes, optimized queries, and memory-efficient execution so large stores stay responsive.

Flexible Configuration

  • Bulk edit settings – batch sizes, threshold limits, and an optimize mode for very large catalogs
  • Analytics settings – toggle the dashboard on or off, configure default date ranges
  • Export settings – choose which fields are included in every CSV export
  • Notification settings – email alerts for completed bulk operations, errors, and sync events

Who Shop Explorer Is For

  • WooCommerce store owners managing catalogs of 100 to 100,000+ products who want everything in one place
  • E-commerce managers tired of switching between several plugins to do daily tasks
  • Digital agencies managing WooCommerce stores for multiple clients who need a faster admin interface
  • Developers who want a clean, modern admin to hand off to clients
  • Anyone frustrated with the slow, fragmented default WooCommerce admin experience

Privacy, Security, and AI Data

  • Chat data is stored locally in your WordPress database, with no third-party data storage
  • GDPR compliant, with built-in data export, anonymization, and retention controls
  • Encrypted API communication with all AI providers
  • No data is sent to any external server except your chosen AI provider’s API
  • Session security and XSS protection built in

AI provider APIs used: api.openai.com (OpenAI), api.deepseek.com (DeepSeek), generativelanguage.googleapis.com (Google Gemini), api.anthropic.com (Anthropic Claude), api.x.ai (X.AI Grok), and openrouter.ai (OpenRouter). Full terms of service and privacy policy links for each provider are listed in the plugin’s Privacy section.

External Services

This plugin connects to external services only when the relevant integration is enabled or feature is used by the site administrator.

Freemius Checkout

Loads the Freemius checkout script when a user opens the Pro upgrade modal in the WordPress admin. The script is served from checkout.freemius.com. No personal data or form submission data is sent.
Terms: https://freemius.com/terms/ | Privacy: https://freemius.com/privacy/

WPAzleen Settings API

Loads display configuration for the Pro upgrade modal in the plugin admin area. No personal data or form submission data is sent.
Privacy: https://wpazleen.com/privacy-policy

AI provider

The only external connection is the AI provider API you choose to use.
AI provider endpoints:
– https://api.openai.com/v1/ (OpenAI)
– https://api.deepseek.com/v1/ (DeepSeek)
– https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/ (Google Gemini)
– https://api.anthropic.com/ (Anthropic Claude)
– https://api.x.ai/ (X.AI Grok)
– https://openrouter.ai/api/ (OpenRouter)

Full terms of service and privacy policy links for each provider are in the plugin’s Privacy section.

Compatibility

  • All WooCommerce product types: Simple, Variable, Grouped, External/Affiliate
  • All standard and custom WooCommerce order statuses
  • WordPress Multisite compatible
  • Built following WordPress coding standards and WooCommerce best practices
  • Zero frontend footprint – no impact on site speed or customer experience

Competitor Analysis

Search the WordPress plugin directory for a WooCommerce bulk edit or store management plugin and a handful of names come up again and again, so it is worth being clear about where Shop Explorer actually fits among them.

WooCommerce Dashboard, Abandoned Cart Recovery, Google Sheets Sync, Inventory Management & Bulk Editor is the closest match. It is also a free, all-in-one admin replacement with its own bulk editor, real-time analytics dashboard, order management, and inventory tools, so anyone comparing the two is comparing like for like. Where BrikPanel pulls ahead is breadth outside the core workflow: abandoned cart recovery, a live visitor widget, and native Google Sheets sync. Shop Explorer pulls ahead on AI: an AI content generator that writes product names, descriptions, and pricing from a single prompt, AI-written revenue analysis with specific recommendations, and an Ask Anything chat assistant that answers questions about your store data directly, none of which BrikPanel’s free version includes.

Advanced WooCommerce Bulk Edit & Inventory Management is a mature, spreadsheet-style editor that can bulk edit almost any WordPress post type and custom field, not just WooCommerce products, and it has a large Pro add-on library for advanced workflows like scheduled edits and undo history. That depth is real, but most of it, including CSV export and most bulk actions, sits behind the Pro tier. Shop Explorer’s free version bulk edits full WooCommerce catalogs, orders, and customers with CSV export included, and adds the AI dashboard and chat assistant Smart Manager does not offer at any tier.

Beyond those two, most of the other names that show up nearby are solving a narrower problem, not a weaker version of the same one. Bulk Edit Products for WooCommerce – WP Sheet Editor, Bulk Edit Categories and Tags, and Bulk Edit Coupons for WooCommerce are three separate spreadsheet-style editors from the same developer, each scoped to one data type (products, taxonomy terms, or coupons), with the free tier limited to a handful of fields per plugin. Bulky – Bulk Edit Products for WooCommerce is a straightforward bulk field editor for products, orders, and coupons with no order management panel, customer database, or analytics dashboard attached. Product Import Export for WooCommerce – Import Export Product CSV Suite is built for moving product data in and out of WooCommerce through CSV files, migrations, and catalog transfers, including AI-generated descriptions during import, rather than for editing an existing live catalog in place.

So of everything that turns up in a “WooCommerce bulk edit” or “WooCommerce management” search, only BrikPanel and Smart Manager are actually built for the same job as Shop Explorer: managing products, orders, customers, and store performance from one dashboard. Between those two and the more focused spreadsheet and import/export tools, Shop Explorer’s combination of full bulk editing, order and customer management, a real-time analytics dashboard, and built-in AI tools, all in the free version, is what sets it apart.

Connect & Support

  • Facebook: facebook.com/wpazleens
  • YouTube Tutorials: youtube.com/@wpazleen
  • X / Twitter: x.com/wpazleen
  • Love Shop Explorer? Leave a Review

Source Code

The source files for all compiled/minified JavaScript and CSS in this plugin are publicly available at:

https://github.com/wpazleen/shop-explorer

Build instructions:

  1. Clone the repository.
  2. Run npm install in the root to install dependencies.
  3. Run npm run build to compile the JavaScript and CSS assets.
  4. The compiled files are output to /build.

The React admin app source is located in src/ and is built with npm run build from the react/ directory.
sections.installation:
Automatic Installation (Recommended)

  1. Go to Plugins → Add New in your WordPress dashboard
  2. Search for “Shop Explorer”
  3. Click Install Now, then Activate

Manual Installation

  1. Download the plugin .zip file from WordPress.org
  2. Go to Plugins → Add New → Upload Plugin
  3. Upload the .zip file and click Install Now
  4. Click Activate Plugin

Requirements

  • WordPress 6.7 or higher
  • WooCommerce 7.0 or higher (must be installed and active)
  • PHP 7.4 or higher (PHP 8.x recommended for best performance)

Initial Setup

  1. After activation, click Shop Explorer in your WordPress admin sidebar
  2. Your live analytics dashboard loads automatically with your WooCommerce data
  3. Use the top navigation to switch between Dashboard, Products, Orders, and Customers
  4. Visit Settings to configure batch sizes, thresholds, and notification preferences
sections.faq:
What does Shop Explorer do?

Shop Explorer is a WooCommerce store management plugin that combines bulk product editing, order management, customer management, and AI-powered revenue analytics in a single WordPress admin dashboard. It replaces the need to run separate plugins for each of those tasks.

How do I bulk edit WooCommerce products with Shop Explorer?

Open Shop Explorer > Products, filter or search for the products you want to change, select them, and choose a bulk action such as updating price, stock, category, or status. A threshold system and validation engine check the change before it writes to your database, and a progress bar shows live results.

How does the AI revenue analysis work?

The AI revenue analysis reads your live WooCommerce sales data and turns it into plain-language insights about trends, growth, and conversion opportunities, using the AI provider you connect (OpenAI, Google Gemini, Anthropic Claude, DeepSeek, X.AI, or OpenRouter). It gives specific suggestions based on your actual numbers rather than generic advice.

How do I install and set up Shop Explorer?

Install it from Plugins > Add New like any WordPress plugin, activate it, and the dashboard loads automatically using your existing WooCommerce data. No import or migration step is required. To use AI features, add your own API key under Settings > AI Provider after installation.

Do I need to configure anything before I can bulk edit products?

No. Shop Explorer reads your existing WooCommerce catalog on activation, so you can start filtering and bulk editing products immediately. Batch sizes and threshold limits have sensible defaults but can be adjusted under Settings if you manage a very large catalog.

Is Shop Explorer compatible with my WooCommerce setup?

Yes. Shop Explorer works with any standard WooCommerce installation and supports all product types, including Simple, Variable, Grouped, and External. All data is read and written using WooCommerce’s native functions and hooks, so it stays compatible with other WooCommerce extensions.

Is Shop Explorer compatible with WordPress Multisite?

Yes. Shop Explorer is built to work on WordPress Multisite installations the same way it works on a single site.

Does Shop Explorer work with my theme or page builder?

Yes, with any of them. Shop Explorer runs entirely inside the WordPress admin as a React application and has zero frontend footprint, so it does not touch your theme, page builder, or storefront templates in any way.

What PHP and WordPress versions does Shop Explorer require?

Shop Explorer requires WordPress 6.7 or higher, WooCommerce 7.0 or higher, and PHP 7.4 or higher. PHP 8.x is recommended for the best performance on large catalogs.

How accurate is the analytics and revenue data?

All data is pulled directly from your WooCommerce database in real time. Revenue figures, order counts, and AOV calculations use WooCommerce’s own data structures, with no sampling, estimation, or third-party data source involved.

Is it safe to bulk edit thousands of products at once?

Yes. A threshold system warns you before any large-scale change runs, and a validation engine checks for errors before writing anything to the database. You can also set the maximum number of records a single operation is allowed to affect.

Will Shop Explorer slow down my website?

No. Shop Explorer runs entirely inside the WordPress admin and has zero frontend footprint, so your customers never load any code from this plugin. Admin-side queries use pagination and batching, so stores with 50,000+ products and orders stay fast and responsive.

Can I bulk edit WooCommerce product variations?

Yes. Variation-specific pricing, stock levels, and attributes can all be updated in bulk through the product editor and bulk operations panel.

Is Shop Explorer free?

Yes. Bulk product editing, order management, customer management, the analytics dashboard, and all current AI tools are free. You only pay your chosen AI provider directly for API usage, based on your own volume. A Pro version with scheduled exports and multivendor support is in development, but the current free feature set stays free.

Do the AI features cost extra?

The AI features are part of the plugin, but you bring your own API key from your chosen provider (OpenAI, Google Gemini, Anthropic Claude, DeepSeek, X.AI, or OpenRouter), so usage is billed by that provider based on your store’s volume.

What export formats are supported?

Products, orders, and customers can all be exported to CSV. Order exports support custom field selection so you get the columns your reporting or accounting workflow needs.

Is Shop Explorer a good free alternative to Bulky – Bulk Edit Products for WooCommerce?

Bulky handles bulk product, order, and coupon field editing well and is a solid free choice if bulk editing is all you need. Shop Explorer covers the same bulk product and order editing, then adds customer management, a real-time analytics dashboard, and built-in AI tools, all in the free version.

How is Shop Explorer different from Bulk Edit Products for WooCommerce (WP Sheet Editor)?

WP Sheet Editor’s Bulk Edit Products gives you a spreadsheet-style editor for products, which is useful if you prefer editing in a grid, though the free version only edits simple products and a handful of fields. Shop Explorer’s free version bulk edits all product types including variations, and adds order management, customer management, and AI analytics that WP Sheet Editor’s product plugin does not include.

Is Shop Explorer different from Product Import Export for WooCommerce?

Product Import Export for WooCommerce focuses on moving product data in and out of your store via CSV, including AI-generated descriptions during import, and is a strong choice for migrations and catalog transfers. Shop Explorer is built for day-to-day store management rather than one-off imports: bulk editing existing products in place, managing orders and customers, and running live AI revenue analysis.

Does Shop Explorer replace Bulk Edit Categories and Tags or Bulk Edit Coupons for WooCommerce?

Those two plugins from WP Sheet Editor are focused, single-purpose tools for taxonomy terms and coupons in a spreadsheet view. Shop Explorer does not currently offer a dedicated spreadsheet editor for categories, tags, or coupons; it focuses on products, orders, customers, and analytics. If category/tag or coupon spreadsheet editing is your main need, those plugins are purpose-built for it.

How is Shop Explorer different from BrikPanel?

BrikPanel is a strong free, all-in-one WooCommerce admin with its own bulk editor, analytics dashboard, cart recovery, and Google Sheets sync. Shop Explorer covers the same core ground (bulk editing, orders, customers, analytics) and differentiates with built-in AI: an AI content generator, AI-written revenue insights, and a live Ask Anything chat assistant that answers questions about your store data.

How is Shop Explorer different from Smart Manager for WooCommerce?

Smart Manager is a mature, spreadsheet-style bulk editor that goes deep on editing almost any WordPress post type and custom field, with a large Pro feature set for advanced users. Shop Explorer trades some of that field-level depth for a purpose-built store dashboard: bulk editing, orders, customers, live analytics, and AI tools presented as one connected workflow rather than a generic spreadsheet grid.

Does Shop Explorer collect any personal data?

Shop Explorer itself does not send your store data anywhere except to the AI provider you choose, and only when you actively use an AI feature. Chat history and AI-generated content are stored locally in your WordPress database, not on a third-party server.

Is Shop Explorer GDPR compliant?

Yes. Shop Explorer includes built-in data export, anonymization, and retention controls for AI chat data, and does not store any customer data outside your own WordPress database.

My AI features aren’t responding, what should I check?

First confirm you’ve added a valid API key under Settings > AI Provider and that the key has available quota with your provider. If the key is valid, check that your server can make outbound HTTPS requests to the provider’s API endpoint, since some hosts block outbound connections by default.

Where can I get support?

Free support is available in the WordPress.org support forum. Priority support is available at wpazleen.com/support.

How do I report a bug?

Report bugs through the WordPress.org support forum with details on what you were doing and any error messages you saw. For urgent issues, priority support is available at wpazleen.com/support.

Is there a Pro version?

Yes, a Pro version is available and includes features such as scheduled exports, advanced product analytics, and undo/rollback history.
Follow WPAzleen on our official landing page and WPAzleen on Facebook for the latest features, updates, and announcements.
sections.changelog:
1.5.0 – 14 July 2026

  • New: Introduced Expenses analytics to monitor and manage business operating costs.
  • Improved: Upgraded Revenue Analytics with enhanced sales performance metrics and trend analysis.
  • New: Introduced a Conversion Funnel report to help track customer conversions from visit to purchase.

1.4.2 – 11 July 2026

  • Improved: Enhanced overall UI/UX across the plugin.
  • Improved: Refined the Dashboard, Orders, and Products pages for a better user experience.

1.4.1 – 23 June 2026

  • Fix: Resolved compatibility conflict with Google for WooCommerce

1.4.0 – 06 June 2026

  • New: Added new product fields to the Common and Individual editors
  • New: Added an “Edit Together” toggle to switch between bulk and individual editing directly from the table
  • Improved: Faster data loading on the Products, Orders, and Revenue pages
  • Improved: Compatibility with WordPress 7.0

1.3.0 – 05 May 2026

  • New: AI Revenue Analysis for sales trends, growth patterns, and store performance
  • New: Ask Anything AI chat for real-time, data-driven answers about your store
  • New: Actionable AI recommendations to improve conversions and revenue
  • New: Conversation memory so the AI remembers previous queries for follow-ups
  • New: AI Content Generator for product names, descriptions, pricing, SKU, and stock
  • New: Instant analytics filtering for faster decision-making

A full version history is available in changelog.txt.

Freemius Checkout

Loads the Freemius checkout script when a user opens the Pro upgrade modal in the WordPress admin. The script is served from checkout.freemius.com. No personal data or form submission data is sent.
Terms: https://freemius.com/terms/ | Privacy: https://freemius.com/privacy/

WPAzleen Settings API

Loads display configuration for the Pro upgrade modal in the plugin admin area. No personal data or form submission data is sent.
Privacy: https://wpazleen.com/privacy-policy

Competitor Analysis

Search the WordPress plugin directory for a WooCommerce bulk edit or store management plugin and a handful of names come up again and again, so it is worth being clear about where Shop Explorer actually fits among them.

WooCommerce Dashboard, Abandoned Cart Recovery, Google Sheets Sync, Inventory Management & Bulk Editor is the closest match. It is also a free, all-in-one admin replacement with its own bulk editor, real-time analytics dashboard, order management, and inventory tools, so anyone comparing the two is comparing like for like. Where BrikPanel pulls ahead is breadth outside the core workflow: abandoned cart recovery, a live visitor widget, and native Google Sheets sync. Shop Explorer pulls ahead on AI: an AI content generator that writes product names, descriptions, and pricing from a single prompt, AI-written revenue analysis with specific recommendations, and an Ask Anything chat assistant that answers questions about your store data directly, none of which BrikPanel’s free version includes.

Advanced WooCommerce Bulk Edit & Inventory Management is a mature, spreadsheet-style editor that can bulk edit almost any WordPress post type and custom field, not just WooCommerce products, and it has a large Pro add-on library for advanced workflows like scheduled edits and undo history. That depth is real, but most of it, including CSV export and most bulk actions, sits behind the Pro tier. Shop Explorer’s free version bulk edits full WooCommerce catalogs, orders, and customers with CSV export included, and adds the AI dashboard and chat assistant Smart Manager does not offer at any tier.

Beyond those two, most of the other names that show up nearby are solving a narrower problem, not a weaker version of the same one. Bulk Edit Products for WooCommerce – WP Sheet Editor, Bulk Edit Categories and Tags, and Bulk Edit Coupons for WooCommerce are three separate spreadsheet-style editors from the same developer, each scoped to one data type (products, taxonomy terms, or coupons), with the free tier limited to a handful of fields per plugin. Bulky – Bulk Edit Products for WooCommerce is a straightforward bulk field editor for products, orders, and coupons with no order management panel, customer database, or analytics dashboard attached. Product Import Export for WooCommerce – Import Export Product CSV Suite is built for moving product data in and out of WooCommerce through CSV files, migrations, and catalog transfers, including AI-generated descriptions during import, rather than for editing an existing live catalog in place.

So of everything that turns up in a “WooCommerce bulk edit” or “WooCommerce management” search, only BrikPanel and Smart Manager are actually built for the same job as Shop Explorer: managing products, orders, customers, and store performance from one dashboard. Between those two and the more focused spreadsheet and import/export tools, Shop Explorer’s combination of full bulk editing, order and customer management, a real-time analytics dashboard, and built-in AI tools, all in the free version, is what sets it apart.

Source Code

The source files for all compiled/minified JavaScript and CSS in this plugin are publicly available at:

https://github.com/wpazleen/shop-explorer

Build instructions:

  1. Clone the repository.
  2. Run npm install in the root to install dependencies.
  3. Run npm run build to compile the JavaScript and CSS assets.
  4. The compiled files are output to /build.

The React admin app source is located in src/ and is built with npm run build from the react/ directory.
